hero.title: Sound Design Work
hero.subtitle: Combat redesigns, weapon synthesis, spell effects, and creature vocals. All original recordings and processing.

video1.title: God of War: Combat Scene Redesign
video1.description: I replaced all the combat audio with original field recordings and foley. Axe impacts, shield blocks, enemy screams, environmental destruction—recorded, processed, and mixed in Reaper.

video2.title: Baldur's Gate: Spell Effects Remake
video2.description: I remade spell sound effects from Baldur's Gate using layered synths and processed recordings. Fire, ice, and arcane spells—each built from scratch.

video3.title: Weapon Sound Design: Realistic vs. Sci-Fi
video3.description: Two weapons, two worlds. A P2000 pistol with realistic recordings and foley. A futuristic energy weapon built from synths and experimental processing.

video4.title: Fracture Horizon: Linear Sound Design
video4.description: My first-ever sound design project. I replaced all audio for a sci-fi scene—spaceship hums, alarm systems, mechanical doors. Basic, but it taught me the fundamentals of syncing sound to picture.
